parts.label: a
parts.reason: No statement in the specification list covers momentum conservation or collisions (PCLM); M8 statements only cover Newton's laws, forces, friction, pulleys - not impact/momentum. This topic is absent from every statement.

parts.label: b
parts.reason: Impulse and momentum are not mentioned in any 9MA0 statement (only force, weight, moment listed as derived quantities in M6.1); this is out of spec and also depends on part (a).
